translation:
Heading: Now begins the Shri Hindola (the swing song) ||28||

Refrain, repeated through the song: "O swing! - yoga, the union with God, is the essence of the whole inner spiritual path."

1. Let us meditate on Hari the formless; let us worship that Parabrahma. Let us long for the stainless state, O swing - the state where there is neither birth nor death. O swing - yoga is the essence of the spiritual path.

2. O swing - the Vedas cannot reach the far shore of his glory. O swing - day and night, meditation on Parabrahma. O swing - that is the resting place of the soul. O swing - yoga is the essence of the spiritual path.

3. Let us give up the pleasures that perish, and the many rich enjoyments of heaven too. Let us serve instead the happiness that never breaks off, O swing - the union of the devotee with Parabrahma. O swing - yoga is the essence of the spiritual path.

4. The sorrow of ten million births is cast away, and supreme bliss has arisen. Let us sway in the happiness of the liberated state, O swing - for the primal Mukund has been met and embraced. O swing - yoga is the essence of the spiritual path.

5. Gods and great sages have served him, yet the Lord does not grant them his darshan (sight of himself). The Vaishnavs reach him effortlessly, O swing - there, where "I" and "mine" do not exist. O swing - yoga is the essence of the spiritual path.

6. By sacrifices, by charity, by vows and by austerities my births were not brought to an end. You are all-powerful - now let me serve you, O swing - now, now let there be deliverance from the womb. O swing - yoga is the essence of the spiritual path.

7. The bonds of karma have been cut through, and the four sources of birth have been brought to their close (sanzeri). The path of death has been shut off, O swing - Parabrahma is the very life-breath of his devotee. O swing - yoga is the essence of the spiritual path.

8. Knowledge and dispassion were made the festive arch, and Shankar and Brahma its two pillars. Desireless bhakti is the little swing, O swing - and on it Hari Parabrahma sways and sways. O swing - yoga is the essence of the spiritual path.

9. At the first push of the swing he shaped the world; at the second he sustains the universe; at the third he gathers the three worlds back into himself, O swing - and at the fourth there is no creation left at all. O swing - yoga is the essence of the spiritual path.

10. The poet makes his prayer with the word that is Brahman: O King Parabrahma, give heed. There is none who knows more than you, O swing - now carry this soul across. O swing - yoga is the essence of the spiritual path.

11. O swing - the Vedas cannot reach the far shore of his glory. O swing - day and night, meditation on Parabrahma. O swing - that is the resting place of the soul. O swing - yoga is the essence of the spiritual path.

Closing: Here the Hindola is complete ||28||

Colophon: The fifth vishram (resting-section) of the five-day parayan (recitation) is complete.
